title: Isolating Culture Neurons in Multilingual Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Identifying culture-specific neurons using Culture Activation Probability Entropy (CAPE) and measuring changes in model perplexity on the culturally diverse MUREL dataset after ablating these targeted neurons.
Identifying language-specific neurons using Language Activation Probability Entropy (LAPE) and evaluating the impact of their ablation on model perplexity across texts in different languages.
